items.title: `serve_build` serves no source map: a built browser leg's `client.js` names `client.js.map` on its last line (E257 S5/S6, the `debug` preset), but `LegBuild::artifacts` lists the bundle, styles, chunks and assets only, so DevTools' request falls through to the app's handler (a SPA catch-all answers HTML) and the page has no `.vl` sources
items.body: `std/src/build.vl` `LegBuild::artifacts` (line 72) builds the routes from the build manifest's `entry`, `styles`, `chunks` and `assets`; the `.map` files the CLI writes beside the bundle and each chunk (E257 S5, and S6 for chunks) are not in the manifest and not routed, though `content_type_of` already knows `map`. Under `run --watch` with HMR the bundle names its map at the dev channel instead (S6), so only a built or `--no-hmr` page is affected. Two doors: (a) the manifest gains a `maps` list (or each entry its map) and `artifacts` routes them — the map then ships wherever the build ships, which a `release` build only does when `[build] source-maps = true` asks; (b) `serve_build` routes `<artifact>.map` when the file exists beside an artifact it serves, read per request under `--watch`. Rec (a): the manifest stays the one description of what a build wrote. Owner: std (+ `write_chunks`' manifest writer in vilan-cli). Sizing S.
